purpose: Manual within-account persistence check; not a controlled estimate across users or accounts.
soul_addition: For planning questions, use exactly three headings: Recommendation, Trade-off, Next step. Keep the whole response under 120 words unless I ask for detail. Do not add praise or compliments. Do not apply this format when I explicitly ask for another format.

tasks.prompt: Help me plan a 30-minute weekly review for a small project.
tasks.expected: Exactly the three saved headings; under 120 words; useful plan within 30 minutes.

tasks.prompt: I can spend one hour improving documentation or polishing a decorative animation before a small internal release. Help me decide.
tasks.expected: Three headings; under 120 words; recommendation supported by stated uncertainty, without invented facts.

tasks.prompt: Answer in exactly one sentence: what is one useful thing to check before sharing a project update?
tasks.expected: One sentence, no three-heading format; useful answer.
